api-docs.png.app_state: the API serving models/pipeline.joblib, with the compose stack up and the prediction log reachable
api-docs.png.command: docker compose up -d, then the page in a browser at the address below
api-docs.png.data_source: none: the page is the OpenAPI schema FastAPI generates from the models
api-docs.png.demonstrates_behaviour: the six routes the service exposes, and the request and response shapes a caller is validated against
api-docs.png.source: taken by the author, from the stack running locally

api-prediction.png.app_state: the same service, after one POST /predict from the documentation page
api-prediction.png.command: docker compose up -d, then the page in a browser at the address below
api-prediction.png.data_source: one applicant typed into the request body, three bureau scores of it
api-prediction.png.demonstrates_behaviour: what a caller receives: the probability, the decision, the threshold that produced it, and the model version
api-prediction.png.source: taken by the author, from the stack running locally

drift-report.png.app_state: no service: the report is a file, opened after the run
drift-report.png.command: docker compose up -d, then the page in a browser at the address below
drift-report.png.data_source: the reference sample of the training population against the raw payloads of the logged requests
drift-report.png.demonstrates_behaviour: what Evidently compares and what it flags, on the traffic the replay produced
drift-report.png.source: taken by the author, from the stack running locally
drift-report.png.url: file:// the HTML report scripts/monitoring_drift.py writes

grafana-dashboard.png.app_state: Grafana and Prometheus provisioned from infra/grafana/, scraping the API during the same replay
grafana-dashboard.png.command: docker compose up -d, then the page in a browser at the address below
grafana-dashboard.png.data_source: the Prometheus scrape of /metrics, over the minutes of the replay
grafana-dashboard.png.demonstrates_behaviour: the dashboard is provisioned by the repository: request rate, latency quantiles and the share of requests refused, without a panel built by hand
grafana-dashboard.png.source: taken by the author, from the stack running locally

prediction-log.png.app_state: the interface reading PostgreSQL after scripts/send_sample_traffic.py had replayed 300 applicants of the holdout through the API
prediction-log.png.command: docker compose up -d, then the page in a browser at the address below
prediction-log.png.data_source: the prediction log, which is what the service wrote while answering
prediction-log.png.demonstrates_behaviour: what the service has been deciding: the count, the latency, the mean score, and how the threshold split the traffic
prediction-log.png.source: taken by the author, from the stack running locally

streamlit-scoring.png.app_state: the interface with the API reachable at its default address
streamlit-scoring.png.command: docker compose up -d, then the page in a browser at the address below
streamlit-scoring.png.data_source: the example payload the page opens with
streamlit-scoring.png.demonstrates_behaviour: the same request sent by someone who will not write JSON, and the three metrics the answer is read by
